datasets.dataset_title: CubeSat Cybersecurity Dataset for Intrusion Detection (CuCD-ID): Labelled NOS3/cFS Telemetry (raw + augmented) with COSMOS Reproduction Scripts
datasets.source_environment: NOS3/cFS software-in-the-loop with OpenC3 COSMOS v4 scenario generation
remaining_pre_analysis_gates: recompute artifact SHA-256 values and compare with published values
freeze exact machine-readable field schema used by Study 9
freeze final primary dataset population before row-level endpoint computation
datasets.notes: CuCD-ID v3 passes the source-selection gate. Published hashes are recorded as source evidence only and are not represented as Study 9 byte-level recomputation. Frozen Study 5 evidence is not imported.

datasets.dataset_title: AegisSat: Telemetry dataset of a physical CubeSat environment with labeled attacks
datasets.source_environment: physical Earth-based CubeSat with environment emulator and controlled cyberattack experiments

published_characteristics.experiment_scale: hundreds of experiments reported by the primary paper
published_characteristics.telemetry_cadence: 1 Hz reported by the primary paper
published_characteristics.data_role: satellite telemetry, ground-issued commands, and labelled attack information

repository_persistence_interface.cosmos_data_structure: packet-keyed dictionaries produced by formatCosmosData from packet attribute tuples
repository_persistence_interface.evidence_boundary: Implementation-derived generating/persistence schema evidence only. It is not treated as proof that the exact Zenodo deposit contains every field or uses an identical serialized schema.

datasets.independence_assessment: Scientifically distinct physical/emulation provenance; no evidence identified in the verification phase that it is derived from CuCD-ID or UNSW-IoTSAT.
remaining_pre_inclusion_gates: verify the exact Zenodo deposited-file manifest
verify dataset license from the Zenodo deposited record rather than inferring it from the repository MIT license
record deposited file sizes and checksums or equivalent immutable file identities
bind the exact deposited dataset version used by Study 9
reconcile the deposited dataset field schema with the implementation-derived persistence interface before semantic mapping
datasets.notes: AegisSat receives a provisional selection pass because the research identity, correct public repository, exact repository commit, Zenodo DOI chain, software license, and implementation-derived persistence interface are now bound. Direct Zenodo record retrieval returned HTTP 429 during verification, so deposited file inventory, dataset license, file identities/checksums, and exact deposited schema remain pending and are not inferred.

datasets.dataset_title: UNSW-IoTSAT: A hybrid testbed-derived dataset for enabling cybersecurity research in the smart satellite domain
datasets.source_environment: hybrid cyber-physical smart-satellite testbed with CCSDS-oriented communications, IoT sensor data, RF-layer impairments, and controlled cyberattacks
datasets.independence_assessment: Independently developed UNSW hybrid cyber-physical testbed; no evidence identified in the verification phase that it is derived from CuCD-ID or AegisSat.
remaining_pre_inclusion_gates: resolve reproducibly public access to the released dataset artifact
verify dataset-specific license or rights statement independently of the repository MIT license
bind immutable dataset version and file identities
record released file inventory and hashes
datasets.notes: Repository code and documentation are MIT licensed. Study 9 does not assume that the MIT license covers separately hosted dataset bytes. Strong schema documentation alone does not clear the artifact-access and dataset-license gates.
